I have upvoted but please write the statement as @5DN1L suggested as it's clearer.
There's a small typo here (converted) : • If all the letters in [[n]] are in lowercase, return [[n]] converted to Title Case.

:)

Your contribution has been uploaded twice. Please remove one of them. The other link is:
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/86476616a8a9b075dec77d6f1d63a52d75fa0

Goal
* Please rewrite as follows (although this won't be shown in Reverse mode):
Given a character sequence [[n]],
• If all the letters in [[n]] are in UPPERCASE, return [[n]] converted to lowercase.
• If all the letters in [[n]] are in lowercase, return [[n]] converte to Title Case.
• If [[n]] is in Title Case, return [[n]] converted to UPPERCASE.
• In all other situations, return {{None}}.

For this clash, a sequence is in Title Case if all the letters are in lowercase except for the first letter of each word (which is in uppercase).

Output
* Please rewrite as follows (although this won't be shown in Reverse mode):
[[n]] in the converted case, or {{None}}.

Thanks.
